rachats.citation: SGS is pleased to announce the acquisition of a majority stake in Maine Pointe LLC, headquartered in the USA with offices in Canada and Europe.

SGS is pleased to announce that the acquisition of SYNLAB Analytics & Services was substantially completed on December 31, 2020 including the transfer of funds. / The purchase consideration is expected to be approximately EUR550 million (USD652 million)
SGS a notamment racheté les entreprises Securitest en 2004, Autosécurité en 2005, Am’tech medical en 2010, Sercovam en 2012, Le Brigand NDT en 2015, Thomas J. Stephens & Associates en 2020.
SGS is pleased to announce the acquisition of Brightsight, the leading cybersecurity evaluation laboratory network for chip-based secure payment systems, secure identity solutions
On 7 July 2022, the Group has acquired proderm GmbH, a clinical research organization, specialized in advanced solutions for cosmetics and personal care as well as medical clinical studies.

100% of Beta Analytic, the global leader in Carbon 14 testing for governmental, academic and commercial organizations worldwide. Beta Analytic is based in Miami, Florida, USA (effective 1 November 2024)

100% of ArcLight Wireless Inc., a world-class leader in systems engineering, network services, technical outsourcing and field testing for the wireless industry, based in North Carolina, USA (effective 1 May 2024)
100% of Gossamer, a world-class provider of cybersecurity evaluation, testing and consulting services for connected services, headquartered in Maryland, USA (effective 1 August 2024)

96.05% of Institut d’Expertise Clinique, a leading cosmetics Clinical Research Organization active in the field of advanced clinical testing solutions, headquartered in Lyon, France (effective 1 October 2024)

100% of Independent Metallurgical Operations Pty Ltd and Metallurgy Pty Ltd (collectively known as IMO), two leading providers of metallurgical consulting, testing, site operations and technical services based in Perth, Australia (effective 1 April 2025)

100% of Aster Global Environmental Solutions, Inc., an industry-leading company focused on validation and verification of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and offsets ... based in the USA (effective 1 January 2025)

SGS, the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification company, announces the successful completion of the acquisition of Applied Technical Services (ATS), following the clearance of all regulatory approvals. / SGS has agreed to acquire Applied Technical Services ... in a deal valued at $1.325 billion.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
